title: Croatian Fish Stew
description: A nourishing and velvety fish stew with a citrusy flavor, perfect for a sick day, featuring a pescatarian-friendly ingredient list and a unique leaf-wrap-steam cooking method
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes
Add the cod fillets, lemon juice, water, salt, and black pepper, and stir gently
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes
Wrap the fresh spinach leaves around the pot lid to create a steam trap
Continue to simmer the stew for an additional 5 minutes, allowing the spinach to steam and infuse the stew with its flavor
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional lemon juice and spinach leaves if desired
